To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the most important elements of the design of quality e-learning material are: (1) Scenario, (2) Feedback, (3) Delivery, (4) Context, (5) Content Design and Writing.

(a) e-learning materials should be designed and developed with the learner in mind; (b) e-learning materials must be learner-centered and must be designed and developed to support learning; (c) e-learning materials need to be designed and developed in a way that they are accessible and easy to use for all learners; and (d) e-learning materials are not only a means to an end but they are also an end in themselves.
